chunks: From him, from ʿAlī ibn Asbāṭ, from his uncle Yaʿqūb ibn Sālim al-Aḥmar, from Abī Baṣīr, from Abī ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, who said:
I asked him: “Is ghusl (ritual bath) upon her like the ghusl of the junub?” He said: “Yes,” meaning the menstruating woman.

key_terms.غُسْلِ الْجُنُبِ: the ritual bath performed for the state of janabah

ai.seo_question: Does a menstruating woman perform ghusl like the ghusl of janabah?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling that the menstruating woman is required to perform ghusl (ritual bath) in a manner like the ghusl of the person in janabah. It pertains to the rulings of ritual purity following menstruation.
